method: A signed work-lane Git archive selected the Publisher package, test, and fixtures; its SHA-256 was checked after transfer to the native guest.
The native test packed Publisher, installed the archive offline with scripts disabled, and executed the relocated public CLI against a selected executable Provider.
The rejected Provider descendant exited before test completion; an unrelated sentinel remained alive.
A separate test replayed the historical v1 Provider, Candidate, and Qualification contracts from frozen fixture bytes.
The guest result and full log were read back independently; the guest and host log SHA-256 values agreed.

cases: packed Publisher executes a relocated Provider and reclaims a rejected descendant
packed work-lane Publisher replays historical v1 contracts offline

limits: This is a local, provisional historical-v1 installed probe, not the frozen successor release or hosted Publisher CI.
It does not qualify successor v2 Provider composition, complete dependency observation, browser or human review, or source-product acceptance.
The raw log remains local in ignored test work; this record is an attributed observation and must be rerun on frozen release bytes.
